# Support — Vars

Var definitions are derived from `module.lowdefy.yaml`. Pass these via the `vars:` block in your app's `lowdefy.yaml` entry for this module.

## Summary

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pelican_url` | string | `https://pelican.lowdefy.app` |  | Origin of the Pelican deployment holding the support app, no trailing slash. Every deployment of an app talks to production Pelican; only building this module points it elsewhere. |
| `environment` | string |  | Yes | The deployment that filed a ticket: production, staging or development. Sent with every ticket and shown on it. Set it from a build-time env var, never guess it at runtime. |
| `app_version` |  |  |  | The app's version, sent with every ticket and shown on it. |
| `types` | array | _(see manifest)_ |  | The ticket types offered on the report form, as { value, label, description }. Values are Pelican's ticket types (bug, question, feature_request, feedback); labels and descriptions are the app's. |
| `context` | object | `{}` |  | Runtime operators evaluated when a ticket is sent, into its context's `extra`. For facts about the user's situation the module cannot know, such as the record they are looking at. |
| `mask_selectors` | array | `[]` |  | CSS selectors blanked in screenshots before the capture, beside the built-in ones (password inputs and `[data-support-mask]`). |
| `user` | object | `{"id":{"_user":"id"},"name":{"_user":"name"},"email":{"_user":"email"}}` |  | Runtime operators resolving to the reporter as { id, name, email }, sent to Pelican on every call. Pelican matches the reporter by id, then by email. The default reads the session; an app whose session keeps these elsewhere points them there. Always from the session, never from a payload. |
| `organization` |  |  |  | Runtime operator resolving to the organisation a ticket is filed from, as { id, name }, or null. Sent as the ticket's `context.organization` and recorded on the copy. Null (the default) sends the session's active organisation, or null for a user with none. |
| `launcher` | object |  |  | The help button that opens the support panel. |

## Nested var details

### `launcher`

The help button that opens the support panel.

| Name | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `show` | boolean | `true` |  | Show the help button to signed-in users. It never shows without a session. |
| `label` | string | `Help` |  | Text on the help button. |
| `placement` | string | `bottom-left` |  | Corner the help button and its panel dock to. Use the corner the ai-assistant module's `panel_placement` does not. Enum: `bottom-left`, `bottom-right` |
